result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: the bottom navigation is clipped and obscured by a thick indicator bar, and the favorite heart button styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is cut off at the bottom edge and obscured by an abnormally thick black home-indicator bar, leaving search, saved and profile icons barely visible and largely untappable
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area padding for the tab bar and restore the system home indicator to its thin standard size so all tab icons are fully visible and tappable

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no circular background while the pizza card below shows heart inside a dark translucent circle, creating inconsistent styling
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular background container to all favorite/heart buttons on restaurant cards
